title: Oil High Limit Tripped
fullDescription: Pitco SG, SSH, Solstice, and Frialator series fryers lock out at E01 when oil exceeds the safety high limit. Causes include stuck contactor, gas valve, or failed temperature probe. Hot oil hazard - allow full cooldown before service.

fixSteps.title: Cooldown
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; allow oil to cool fully before any service.

fixSteps.title: Reset high-limit
fixSteps.instruction: Press manual reset button on high-limit thermostat.

fixSteps.title: Diagnose root cause
fixSteps.instruction: Test contactor, probe, and gas valve to identify cause.

whenToCallPro: Hot oil and gas systems need qualified service.

faq.a: Runaway oil heat can cause fire; never bypass safeties.

title: Probe Open / Out of Range
fullDescription: E02 fires when the oil temperature probe is open or shorted. The fryer will not heat without valid feedback to prevent runaway temperatures.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat probe connector; check for damage.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Drain cool oil and install new probe.

whenToCallPro: If probe is good, controller may need replacement.

faq.a: Yes, generic probes can give wrong readings.

title: Heating Failure / Recovery Slow
shortDescription: Oil temperature not rising at expected rate.
fullDescription: E03 fires when oil does not warm up at expected rate. Causes include low oil level, failed element, gas valve, or contactor.

fixSteps.title: Top up oil
fixSteps.instruction: Add fresh oil to fill line.

fixSteps.title: Test heat source
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, drain. Test elements or gas valve.

whenToCallPro: Element and gas valve replacement should be done by service.

faq.a: Manual lists rated recovery rate per model and oil capacity.

title: Ignition Failure (Gas)
fullDescription: Pitco gas fryers use spark or hot-surface ignition. E04 fires when ignition module cannot confirm flame within trial. Causes include closed gas, dirty pilot/electrode, failed module.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm shutoffs open, inlet pressure correct.

fixSteps.title: Service ignitor
fixSteps.instruction: Clean or replace ignitor and flame sensor.

whenToCallPro: Gas system work should be done by qualified service.

faq.a: Shut off, ventilate, do not operate switches, call gas tech.

title: Filter Pump Fault
shortDescription: Built-in filter pump did not run or tripped overload.
fullDescription: Solstice Filter and Solstice Supreme have built-in filtration. E05 indicates pump motor stalled or overloaded. Often clogged filter paper or debris.

fixSteps.title: Reset overload
fixSteps.instruction: Press reset button on pump overload.

faq.a: Daily or per shift depending on volume.

title: Drain Valve Open
shortDescription: Drain valve detected open during heat.
fullDescription: E06 prevents heating when the drain valve is open. Heating with no oil warps the frypot and is a fire risk.
whenToCallPro: If switch good, controller may need service.

faq.a: Never; bypassing drain switch can cause fires.

title: Oil Level Low
fullDescription: Solstice Supreme units monitor oil level. E07 indicates frypot needs top-up. Refill JIB and trigger top-off.

fixSteps.title: Refill JIB
fixSteps.instruction: Replace empty oil jug or top up.

faq.a: Use the oil specified for your menu and frypot.

title: Power Vent Fault
shortDescription: Power exhaust fan or pressure switch fault.
fullDescription: Pitco gas fryers with power exhaust monitor fan. E08 fires if fan fails or pressure switch does not close. Burner cannot light without verified exhaust.

faq.a: No; venting safety is required by code.

title: Filter Pan Missing
shortDescription: Filter pan not detected in position.
fullDescription: On built-in filter Pitco fryers, the filter pan must be fully inserted. E09 fires if the pan switch indicates missing or partially inserted pan.

fixSteps.title: Reseat pan
fixSteps.instruction: Pull out and reinsert filter pan firmly.

whenToCallPro: Switch fault rare; tech needed for replacement.

faq.a: Until you feel the back stop and switch click.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Display lost link with main board.
fullDescription: E10 means the I12/IPC/SoloFilter controller cannot talk to the main board. Loose harness, moisture, or board failure are typical.

title: Top-Off Pump Fault
shortDescription: Auto top-off pump did not run.
fullDescription: ATO pump on Pitco BNB or filter-equipped fryers did not energize when needed.
whenToCallPro: Sealed-system, gas, and high-voltage diagnosis on this unit requires a licensed commercial tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: Auto top-off pump did not run.
Some advisory codes self-clear; faults latch and need manual reset after the fix.
